nonClaim: This report separates release-blocking backlog risk from non-blocking deferred backlog; it does not close or rewrite backlog items.

dispositionRules.rule: Only invalid rows, openLikeIds, unresolvedIds, or explicit current release blockers can block the current closeout certificate immediately.
Deferred rows without ownerRefs are not immediate release blockers, but must be converted to task-card ownership or explicitly waived before a final releaseAuthorized=true certificate.
Deferred rows with ownerRefs are already carried by another task or follow-up lane and must not be double-counted as current release blockers.

nextExecutionOrder.whyFirst: 133 deferred items have no ownerRefs; batching them into owner lanes is cheaper and safer than trying to fix every bug inside this closeout.

nextExecutionOrder.whySecond: A small sample should confirm ownerRefs point to real follow-up tasks before final release.

nextExecutionOrder.whyThird: Only after ownership exists should the backlog census and independent certificate be recomputed.

principlesApplied: first-principles: release blocking means current unreconciled risk, not every deferred improvement ever recorded
deep-module: backlog census remains the source of truth while this report adds a release decision layer
80/20 execution: owner-map the deferred backlog instead of attempting 170 unrelated fixes in the closeout lane
false-green prevention: releaseAuthorized remains false until unowned deferred items are task-cardized or explicitly waived
